rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent representation; project retained. Two differences, neither in amount. (1) The second reads Form 5695 line 32 directly; the project reads Schedule 3 line 5b, which is line 32 when Part II is completed (f5695.part2_any) and zero otherwise; the worksheet counts the credits "if you are taking the credit(s)/adjustment(s) on your 2025 income tax return" and "only if allowed and taken", and the credit taken is Schedule 3 line 5b (i5695 p. 5, Residential Clean Energy Credit Limit Worksheet—Line 14, line 2, "Energy efficient home improvement credit, Form 5695, line 32"). (2) When Credit Limit Worksheet B is not completed the second reads Form 1040 line 19; the project's f5695.ctc_line19 is the smaller of Schedule 8812 line 12 and Credit Limit Worksheet A line 3, which is line 19 (Schedule 8812 line 14, the smaller of line 12 and line 13; line 13 is Worksheet A line 3 less line 4, and line 4 is zero: i1040s8812 p. 4, Credit Limit Worksheet A, line 4, "If you are not completing Credit Limit Worksheet B, enter -0-"), figured without reading line 4, which reads Schedule 3 line 5a. When Worksheet A line 3 is negative both give a worksheet line 3 of zero. The Worksheet B branch (Worksheet B line 14) is the same on both sides.

The project checks the box only when Part II is completed (f5695.part2_any) and the filer has a condominium or cooperative share; the second checks it on the condo answer alone. The box is for occupants who are claiming the share: i5695 p. 7, Lines 32a and 32b, "Occupants of a condominium or cooperative who are claiming a fractional share of the qualified energy efficiency improvements or residential energy property costs must check the box on line 32b"; with Part II not completed nothing is claimed. No amount depends on the box.

Ruling: representation; project retained. The binding reading amb.2025.clwb_claiming_part1 is "completing Form 5695 Part I with line 13 ... more than zero"; the second keeps the line 13 test and drops the Part I screen (f5695.part1_any). They differ only when Part I amounts are present with the screen answered No; then Schedule 3 line 5a is zero on both (s3.line5a is zero when f5695.part1_any is No), so Credit Limit Worksheet A line 4 (Worksheet B line 15, Schedule 3 line 5a) is zero either way and no amount on Schedule 8812 or Form 1040 changes. The carryforward alone counts on both sides: f5695 p. 1, Part I, "Note: Skip lines 1 through 11 if you only have a credit carryforward from 2024"; i1040s8812 p. 4, Credit Limit Worksheet A, "Complete Credit Limit Worksheet B only if you meet all the following. 1. You are claiming one or more of the following credits ... c. Residential clean energy credit, Form 5695, Part I".
